options.rule: freeze leaf-only Mqq as ROM/dynamics authority; carry the 2x0.03 kg per wing as RIGID, non-moving interface mass lumped at the hinge lines in the structural mass ledger only
options.consequence: published five-case frequencies stay authoritative as-is; rigid-system mass closure unchanged (0.78 kg/wing already includes the 0.06 kg); ROM kinetic energy excludes hinge-point motion -> consistent but slightly stiffer flexible response
options.required_action: one-line ruling in MPI mass-allocation record; no regeneration of any accepted file

options.consequence: flexible frequencies shift DOWN (nominal: -0.2447 / -2.7319 / -13.1326 Hz, i.e. -3.51% / -6.94% / -13.40%); published FLEXIBLE_APPENDAGE_R2_MODES.json becomes non-authoritative for dynamics and the five-case sweep must be re-published under a new version (upstream regeneration forbidden this round)
options.required_action: MPI ruling + new-version ROM evidence package (later round); e15 scope expands

options.rule: defer: keep both registered, forbid any flexible-dynamics consumption until hinge masses are measured on hardware

options.required_action: explicit HOLD record; compatible with current e21 gate but does not advance closure
